answer: Commit the receipt hash first, reveal the work later, and a mismatched reveal voids the slot. Because auditors rotate from a pool no identity can hold for two epochs, a farm buys a new panel every round. The delta matters more than the absolute: one extra clone adds one more audit draw, so the plume of new addresses raises the farm's exposure faster than its ember of payout. A violet flag on the pool list is enough to re-queue a third panel.
